text:
amanda: FYI - SI (ClearPath) hit a hard blocker on customer staging. Marketplace image boots but inference containers crash on GPU nodes. Need arch review and escalation path. :warning:
jonah: ugh, logs? stack trace? which driver/kernel combo?
amanda: pasted kernel log from VM: `NVRM: GPU at pci:0000:65:00: GPU is lost` and container shows `CUDA driver version is insufficient for runtime` - attaching short snippet.
siva: can you paste the exact docker run / image tag? sometimes marketplace image pins a new CUDA base that older MGX drivers don't like.
amanda: command used: `docker run --gpus all redwood/inference:marketplace-2026-03`
amah: sorry typo earlier, confirming image tag above.
jonah: okay that tag moved to CUDA 12.2 last week - many partners still on 12.1 driver. probable mismatch.
amanda: customer is on puppet-managed on-prem blades from our HW partner (OrionSystems) - they can't easily update drivers during staging window. SI needs a fallback plan for the cutover tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
siva: short-term options: 1) run CPU-only fallback image (downgraded perf), 2) pin older inference runtime / quantized model that uses CUDA 11 compatibility image, 3) coordinate with HW partner to stage driver update (riskier).
mike: looping in OrionSystems contact now - @OrionSystems-inbox, we need driver matrix and firmware notes. I'll ping verbally. :telephone_receiver:
partners-bot: integration checklist: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/marketplace-integration-checklist — new step about driver compatibility added (2026-02-14).
amanda: SI says customer cannot accept CPU fallback (SLA). They prefer option 2 if we can produce a compatible image fast. How long to build/publish a CUDA11-compatible marketplace variant?
siva: estimate: 3-5 hours to build + quick smoke tests if infra team frees a builder. We can also publish a private image tag to the customer's registry sooner.
jonah: can we hotfix the marketplace listing to point to the alternate tag and avoid a full redeploy? that would be fastest for the SI.
siva: yes — we can add an alias in the marketplace manifest to a prebuilt cuda11 variant and toggle routing. Need approvals from marketplace ops.
amanda: timeline: customer cutover in ~12 hours. SI requests a simple rollback plan and a contact rotation. Also need a short architecture review call asap — 30 min to align on rollback, metrics, and who's oncall during cutover.
mike: available 22:00 UTC window for call. I'll confirm OrionSystems eng attendance.
jonah: I'll prepare a one-pager showing differences (driver requirements, perf impact) and a smoke test checklist.
amanda: thanks. Please add required deploy-bot checks: preflight (kernel+driver), smoke (basic infer), and monitor alerts (token-drop, latency spike).
deploy-bot: preflight checklist created: `marketplace/cuda11-fallback/preflight` - results pending.
amanda: perfect. If we can get the alias + private tag up within 4 hours we'll avoid delaying the customer's rollout. tagging @siva @mike — please post updates in this thread. :pray:
